def _require_title(title: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(title, str):

def _remove_punctuation(title: str) -> str:

def _to_words(title: str) -> List[str]:
    words = []
    for part in re.split(r"[\s-]+", title.lower()):
        if part:
            words.append(part)
    return words

def _join_words(words: List[str]) -> str:
